description: Calculate the Acoustic Voice Quality Index (AVQI), a clinically validated dysphonia score. AVQI combines acoustic parameters from a sustained vowel AND connected speech (concatenated). AVQI version is chosen automatically from the patient language (en/nl/de → v02.03; fr/es/it → v03.01). Dysphonia thresholds: > 2.43 (French/Dutch) / > 2.97 (English). BEFORE CALLING: (1) Ask for or infer the patient language (en/fr/nl/es/de/it). (2) Show the user the correct connected speech sentence for that language (read vocametrix://recording-guide to get it) and ask them to record it. (3) Confirm they also have a sustained /a/ vowel recording of 5+ s. Only call once both recordings are confirmed ready.

connectedSpeechPath.description: Connected speech WAV file — patient reads the language-specific reference sentence (see vocametrix://recording-guide)

language.description: Patient language — determines AVQI version and the reference sentence for connected speech

sustainedVowelPath.description: Sustained vowel WAV file (/a/ held 5+ s)
